c.name: Umashikate
c.translated: If this translation and the Japanese version differ, the Japanese version prevails.
lp.desc: Take a photo before and after you eat. They become one card, and each dish becomes a sticker that piles up in your stomach. Your records and photos stay on your iPhone.
lp.f1_h: Before and after, in one card
lp.f1_p: The camera overlays your before photo faintly so you can match the framing. Share the finished card right away.
lp.f2_p: Dishes are cut out into stickers. Tilt your iPhone and they roll; grab them with a finger and toss them around.
lp.f3_h: Look back with a calendar and a food guide
lp.f3_p: Days you ate show their photos on the calendar, and each prefecture you ate in fills a square in the guide.
lp.f4_h: Your records stay on your iPhone
lp.f4_p: No account needed. Photos and records are never sent to the developer's servers.
lp.h1:
Before you eat, and after.
It all goes into the stomach.
lp.lead: One photo before you dig in, one after you finish. The two become a single card, and the dish is cut out of the photo as a sticker that drops into the stomach on your Home. Course meals and forgotten shots are fine too.
lp.plus_p: With a one-time purchase or a weekly plan, ads go away and you get iCloud photo backup, calorie estimates, all filters, custom dish emoji, the map, and themes for the stomach and the app icon. Prices are as shown on the App Store and in the app.
lp.soon: Coming soon to the App Store. Requires an iPhone with iOS 26 or later.
lp.title: Umashikate - A meal camera for before and after
pp.abroad_p: Google LLC, RevenueCat, Inc. and Apple Inc. are US companies, and information may be processed on servers in the United States and elsewhere.
pp.ad_1: To show and measure ads, device information (model, OS, language, etc.), IP address, and records of ads shown or tapped are sent to Google
pp.ad_2: We ask Google not to personalize ads. The app does not ask for tracking permission and does not use the advertising identifier (IDFA)
pp.ad_3: Meal records, photos and places are not sent to Google
pp.ad_4: In the EU, UK, Switzerland and similar regions, Google's consent tool (UMP) shows a screen asking for consent about ads. You can change your choice anytime in the app under Settings > Ad Consent Settings. That item appears only in regions where the consent screen is shown
pp.ad_5: Ads are removed when you purchase Umashikate+
pp.ad_6: See How Google uses information from sites or apps that use its services
pp.ad_p: For people without Umashikate+, we show Google AdMob banner ads (Google LLC) at the bottom of the Eaten, Food Guide and Meal screens. No ads are shown on the Home stomach or the camera.
pp.ai: Reading the dish name, cutting it out of the photo and estimating calories are processed on your iPhone (Apple Intelligence and Vision). Photos are not sent anywhere
pp.apple_1: When looking up place names (nearby places or addresses), coordinates and search words are sent to Apple's Maps services
pp.apple_2: Making your own dish emoji uses Apple's Image Playground, which is handled under Apple's terms
pp.apple_3: If you turn on photo backup, your meal records and photos are stored in your own iCloud. The developer cannot see or retrieve them. Nothing is stored in iCloud unless you turn it on
pp.change_p: We update this page when the app's features or the services it uses change, and announce major changes here.
pp.contact_p: For questions about this policy, use the contact page or email ryo.tsuzukihashi@tsuzukit.com.
pp.del_1: Deleting a meal in the app also deletes its photos from your device. Deleting the app erases all records and photos on the device
pp.del_2: Purchase records are tied to your Apple Account. If you reinstall with the same Apple Account, use Restore Purchases in the app
pp.del_3: To request deletion of information sent to RevenueCat, contact us using the details below
pp.del_icloud: You can delete the iCloud backup on your iPhone under Settings > your name > iCloud > Storage by choosing Umashikate's data
pp.desc: Privacy Policy for Umashikate. Meal records and photos are stored only on your iPhone and are not sent to the developer's servers. Also covers Google AdMob for ads, RevenueCat for purchases, and iCloud backup.
pp.h_2: 2. Data kept only on your iPhone
pp.lede:
Summary
Umashikate has no account or sign-in, and the developer never asks for your name or email address. Meal records, photos and places are stored only on your iPhone and are not sent to the developer's servers. Recognizing dishes, cutting them out and estimating calories all happen on your iPhone. There are no analytics tools. People without Umashikate+ see ads (Google AdMob). We ask Google not to personalize them and do not use the advertising identifier (IDFA), but device information, IP address and similar data are sent to Google to show and measure ads. To process and verify purchases, an anonymous user ID and purchase records are sent to RevenueCat and Apple.
pp.local_p: None of this is sent to the developer's servers. It is erased when you delete the app.
pp.meal: Photos you take (before and after), dish names and emoji, cut-out stickers, titles you add, dates and times
pp.meta: Umashikate / Effective November 13, 2026 / Last updated November 13, 2026
pp.none_p: The app has no analytics tools and no account or sign-in system.
pp.place: Where you ate (coordinates, place name, city), when you allow location access or pick a place yourself
pp.rc_1: The anonymous user ID is not linked to your name or email address
pp.rc_2: Meal records and photos are not sent to RevenueCat or to Apple's purchase system
pp.rc_3: Payments are handled by Apple. Card and other payment details never reach the developer
pp.rc_4: See the RevenueCat Privacy Policy for how RevenueCat handles information
pp.rc_p: We use RevenueCat, Inc.'s service (RevenueCat) to process Umashikate+ purchases. To verify purchases, an anonymous user ID created by the app and purchase records are sent to RevenueCat and Apple.

tm.a1_p: These terms apply to everyone who uses the App ("Users"). The App is distributed through the App Store, and Apple's standard License Agreement (EULA) also applies. If these terms and the EULA conflict, these terms prevail.
tm.a2_p: The App has no account or sign-in. It is for iPhone only and requires iOS 26 or later. Some features, such as dish recognition and calorie estimates, work only on devices that support Apple Intelligence.
tm.a3_1: The App offers a paid plan, "Umashikate+". It removes ads and unlocks iCloud photo backup, calorie estimates, all filters, custom dish emoji, the map, and themes for the stomach and the app icon
tm.a3_2: There are two ways to pay: a one-time lifetime purchase, and a subscription that renews automatically every week. The subscription has no free trial
tm.a3_3: Prices are as shown on the App Store and in the App
tm.a3_4: Subscription charges are billed to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Cancel on your iPhone under Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions. Deleting the App does not cancel it
tm.a3_5: If you cancel mid-period, features remain available until the period ends. When Umashikate+ ends, paid themes and filters return to the defaults and ads appear again. Your meal records and photos are not deleted
tm.a3_6: A lifetime purchase can be restored after switching devices or reinstalling by tapping Restore Purchases with the same Apple Account
tm.a3_7: Refunds follow Apple's policies. Please request them through Apple Support (reportaproblem.apple.com). The Developer cannot issue refunds directly
